title: Dogs, devils, clams and catfish: When cancer is contagious
hook: In Tasmanian devils, dogs, and soft-shell clams, malignant tumors have evolved the terrifying ability to leap between bodies as infectious, parasitic clones.

title: A Change at a Damascus School Has Syrians Reading the Runes
hook: When Damascus's centenary French secular school quietly decreed gender segregation, it ignited an anxious national debate over Syria's shifting cultural identity.

title: The orca brothers preying on great white sharks
hook: Two rogue male orcas off South Africa have mastered surgical strikes on great white sharks, removing their nutrient-dense livers and upending the coastal food chain.

title: “Men with Queer Nerves”: The Jumping Frenchmen of Maine
hook: In late 19th-century logging camps, French-Canadian lumberjacks exhibited a baffling neurological phenomenon: an involuntary startle reflex that forced them to obey any sudden, barked command.

title: Why did Stalin commit a robbery? The bloody heist that made the dictator’s name
hook: Before ruling the Soviet Union, a young Joseph Stalin orchestrated a brazen, bomb-throwing daylight heist of imperial stagecoaches in 1907 Tiflis to bankroll Lenin's Bolsheviks.

title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
hook: Federal investigators tracking the brazen ShinyHunters cyber-syndicate uncovered a staggering twist: key executives at firms hired to negotiate ransoms were allegedly running extortion sites themselves.

title: Kremlin payment firm A7 has been pumping billions in ‘untraceable’ cash into global financial system
hook: Leaked records expose how payment network A7 quietly moved 283 metric tons of physical ruble banknotes out of Moscow trading centers and straight into sanctioned military finance pipelines.

title: Chinese Scam Boss Murdered in Sri Lanka Had Multiple Identities
hook: The mysterious assassination of a cyber-scam kingpin in Colombo uncovers the cross-border labyrinth of counterfeit passports and industrial fraud compounds sprawling across South Asia.

title: ‘If Anything Happens to This Guy … Everyone Is Screwed’
hook: A fascinating look at Ondřej Surý, the obscure open-source maintainer whose quiet volunteer labor patches critical PHP flaws that keep nearly 70 percent of the web running.

title: For the First Time, Scientists Trapped an Elusive Antimatter Particle—and Contained It for Months. It Could Allow Them to Test an Enduring Physics Theory
hook: Physicists have succeeded in trapping elusive antimatter particles for months on end, opening a doorway to finally discovering why our matter-filled cosmos didn't annihilate itself into oblivion.

title: The assassination of the world’s only openly gay imam
hook: A poignant, deeply reported profile of South African imam Muhsin Hendricks, who established a rare inclusive mosque and paid the ultimate price for his radical theological openness.

title: She Was the DEA’s Premier Crypto Detective. The Clues Led Straight to Her Own Family
hook: As the DEA's pioneering crypto-sleuth untangled laundering trails across the dark web, she never imagined the blockchain evidence would point directly to her own family.
